question: The new Indian Ports Bill 2025 seeks to repeal which Indian Act?

options.text: The Indian Bills of Lading Act, 1856

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Indian Ports Act, 1908**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indian Ports Bill, 2025** seeks to repeal the **Indian Ports Act, 1908**, which has been in effect for over a century.
 
• The new Bill aims to bring comprehensive reforms to the **port governance framework** in India.
 
• The **Indian Ports Act, 1908** was designed during colonial times and does not adequately address the modern-day requirements of the port sector.<
